titles.title: หิมะกลางฤดูร้อน
夏に芽吹きし叶わぬ恋

description:
The end of his seven-year unrequited love came with a cruel sentence.

*“I’ve fallen in love with someone. I need your help.”*

From the very first time they met, those words slipped out from between the man’s thin, red lips, piercing his heart.

*“But the thing is, that person isn’t interested in me at all. I was hoping you could help me. I think you’d know what to do.”*

He had no idea how he could possibly help, but he still nodded. If he opened his mouth, he felt like he would break down crying, so all he could do was keep nodding over and over. The ending of a long unrequited love… as a stand-in for someone else’s lover. Was this really going to be okay?
